cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've turned your empty plate over, so I've done mine too. Please give my pie to your brother; I'm quite comfortable with peas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I turned it over because it's chipped. I haven't finished eating, and you haven't started.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, checking the crockery. Don't fetch another for me; peas sit quite nicely round the foot of this one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How kind. You all carry on eating; I'll turn my plate back over when it's time for my dinner.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies overturned plate as finished dinner; A3 never admits confusion and advertises peas; A5 graciously defers own meal.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 chip correction causes A3 crockery cover story; B4 delayed pizza causes A5 waiting plate.

relationship.evidence: B2 notices A hunger and B4 offers replacement food.

heightening.evidence: A5 accepts B4 help while making everyone witness deferred dinner.

specificity.evidence: A1 extra brother and pie offer plus B2 uneaten meal make stakes clear.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 peas around foot is physically odd but explicitly stated; A5 is a single gracious instruction.
